# glad

`include/glad/gl.h` is an OpenGL function loader generated by [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) 2.0.8 and committed as is. It covers OpenGL 3.3 core with no extensions, and its functions are loaded through `glfwGetProcAddress` (see `App.cpp`). The header is header-only: `gl.cpp` compiles the implementation once.

## Regenerating

Install glad into a virtual environment, so its dependencies stay out of your global Python:

```sh
python -m venv gladenv
gladenv/Scripts/pip install glad2==2.0.8    # gladenv/bin/pip on Linux and macOS
gladenv/Scripts/glad --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions= --reproducible --out-path out c --header-only
```

Then copy `out/include/glad/gl.h` over `include/glad/gl.h`. `--reproducible` uses the GL specification bundled with glad instead of fetching the latest one, so the same glad version always generates the same header.

## License

glad's generated code is public domain (WTFPL or CC0-1.0). The header embeds `khrplatform.h` and parts of the Khronos OpenGL registry, which are Apache-2.0. The header's SPDX line records this: `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0`.
